description:
## X Patch 1.12.1-x.2 (2026-10-30)

* Copy media URL: copy the direct video file URL from X's video download action, or continue with Save video.
* Also copies direct photo, video and GIF URLs from post options.
* Retains Fix external post links, Hide Find more and Hide Who to follow.
* Supports X 12.31.0-prod.01 and 12.32.0-prod.01. Android UI and APK-level behavior for the new video action are not yet verified.
* Image long-press and image-viewer overflow menu entry points remain unimplemented.

patches.name: Fix external post links
patches.description: Opens external X post URLs directly in post detail without using the For You tab.

patches.name: Hide Find more
patches.description: Hides Discover more / もっと見つける under posts and top people recommendations in Search.

patches.name: Hide Who to follow
patches.description: Hides Who to follow / recommended-account modules from timelines.

patches.name: Copy media URL
patches.description: Copy direct image/video/GIF URLs from post options or from the video player's download action.

release_notes: X Patch adds an optional Copy media URL action in post options and retains existing link and recommendation improvements. The new copy action and media viewer behavior have not yet been validated on an actual device.
